title: BA Prompt Forge prompt
description: The YAML front-matter of a library/**/*.md file. These fields ARE the prompt: they are format-neutral, and tools/formats.py renders them into CARE, CO-STAR, RISEN, TIDD-EC, RTF and the rest. Never write a prompt as one blob of text - a blob cannot be converted, scored field by field, or diffed in a pull request.

id.description: Role prefix (BB, BT, TB, AB, LB, PL), service number, then M (Master), Dn (Deliverable) or Un (decomposed unit).

derived_from.description: Parent prompt id, for decomposed units.

service.description: The L3 BA service this prompt belongs to.

persona.description: Criterion 1. Who is writing, e.g. 'an agile business analyst (Agile BA)'.

audience.description: Criterion 1. Who reads the output. Decides the format - be specific.

situation.description: Standing facts and the inputs the user will paste.

data_safety.description: Criterion 8. Must give an explicit de-identification instruction, not just mention constraints.

task.description: Criterion 2. One task, strong verb, named inputs.

modes.description: Criterion 2. Two or more modes makes this a Master: a menu, not a task. Caps criterion 2 at 1/2 and cannot carry a regression test. Run tools/decompose.py to split it.

clarifiers.description: How many clarifying questions to ask before drafting.

output_format.description: Criterion 3. Must be checkable: named sections, table columns, counts.

guardrails.description: Criterion 7. Needs both an explicit prohibition on invention AND a flagging convention ([TBC], [PROPOSED - VALIDATE]).

example.description: Criterion 4. A real sample to imitate, with synthetic values. Never a description of an example.

validation.description: Criteria 5 and 6. 'get' renders the standard Generate -> Explain -> Test block.

inputs.description: Criterion 9. The [MARKED PLACEHOLDERS] a user fills in. Derived from the text; do not hard-wire project specifics.

review_needed.description: Open items on a proposal, before it can be promoted into library/.

score.description: Marks against rubric/care-get-v1.yml. tools/lint.py rejects any disagreement on a machine-decidable criterion.

provenance.description: Who wrote it. This is the credit record - it travels with the prompt into every converted format and generated skill.
